decision_principle: A bounded exact-article qualification and functional proof can merit funding before a positive randomized human efficacy trial or a fully licensed asset exists.

updates.exact_use: Pantethine/PPCS-deficiency cardiomyopathy, with chemically distinct pantetheine and 4-prime-phosphopantetheine comparator routes
updates.prior_disposition: Conditional reserve; identity and oral active-species exposure gating

decision_deltas.delta: Human oral PPanSH formulation and completed 77-participant development program recovered; comparator delivery route is concrete.
Posted randomized exploratory biomarker trend does not confirm strong dose-response; protocol-versus-posted analysis mismatch limits interpretation.
Existing OHSU/Spoonbill medical-food pathway and petition require differentiated PPCS functional value rather than first oral bypass claim.
No recovered source links oral pantethine dose to a validated active-species myocardial exposure or transfers PPanSH efficacy to PPCS.

Two patient cardiac backgrounds and force stabilization rather than significant increase

comparator_trial.protocol_objective: Safety, tolerability and exploratory blood CoASY pharmacodynamics for medical-food development; not conventional maximum tolerated dose finding or cardiac efficacy trial.

early_CoASY_mRNA.time_interpretation: Model includes one-month versus three-day visits; not one day-33 sample.
early_CoASY_mRNA.measure: geometric least squares mean ratio to baseline

six_month_CoASY_mRNA.measure: geometric least squares mean ratio to baseline
six_month_CoASY_mRNA.posted_hypothesis: No significant variation at this time point

outcome_summary.serious_AE_interpretation: All-cause registry table, severe disease population; do not attribute drug causation from counts alone.

analysis_concordance.protocol_early: Pooled active-versus-placebo contrast around 3 plus/minus 2 days, two-sided alpha .1
analysis_concordance.posted_early: Ordered high > mid > low > placebo trend across early visits, p=.105
analysis_concordance.protocol_six_month: Expected lower expression at higher active doses; low > mid > high > placebo contrast
analysis_concordance.posted_six_month: High > mid > low > placebo trend and stated no-significant-difference hypothesis, p=.55
analysis_concordance.interpretation: Unresolved reporting/analysis mismatch. Do not label as clean prespecified negative clinical efficacy RCT; do not claim confirmatory dose-dependent PD.

comparator_trial.dataset_overlap: Later open-label participants include the randomized cohort; 12 additional direct-open-label entrants. No PPCS clinical/model overlap claimed.

current_program.status_limit: Notice of filing is not additive approval or drug/PPCS approval. No later final approval found; not exhaustive legal clearance.
current_program.stock_status: Development/manufacturing route, not current stock confirmation

updates.first_fundable_question: Which authenticated precursor and deliverable formulation produces useful PPCS cardiac force/fatigue improvement or preservation after a qualified deficit at plausible active-species exposure?
updates.model_route: Independent commercially usable PPCS backgrounds require qualification; current restricted patient-line entries are not ready unrestricted models. Include isogenic controls, disease baseline and post-deficit functional positive control.
advance_conditions: Exact PanSH, PanSSPan or PPanSH article linked to measured matrix species
Useful repeatable force/fatigue or preservation with coherent exposure across independent disease backgrounds
Meaningful effect beyond CoA biomarker restoration
Defined incremental PPCS product value compared with established oral PPanSH pathway
stop_or_redirect_conditions: Activity confined to undeliverable assay-specific redox mixture
Biochemical correction without useful function in a demonstrably responsive model
No increment over comparator; if only preservation is shown, stop reversal claim and evaluate preservation separately
uncertainties: Oral active species and myocardial exposure
Exact transferable CoA-Z formulation specification and current supply
Clinical causal attribution and target population
updates.inference_not_fact: The comparator route strengthens the case for a small exact-species qualification project without establishing PPCS clinical benefit or S-tier status.
